description:
Found in defk-9p6.13 (cosine_topk.exs). Repro (Defk.Report with report: :full):

  defk scores(m :: [f32], q :: [f64]) :: [f64] do
    dim = len(q)
    n = div(len(m), dim)
    out = alloc(f64, n)
    for r <- 0..(n - 1)//1 do
      out[r] = for j <- 0..(dim - 1)//1, reduce: 0.0 do
        acc -> acc + m[r * dim + j] * q[j]
      end
    end
    out
  end

Report: 'm[r * dim + j]: bounds check kept; nothing proves 0 <= r * dim + j and r * dim + j < len(m)' and 'out[r]: bounds check kept; nothing proves r < len(out)' (the second is surprising: out = alloc(f64, n) and r <- 0..(n - 1)). With a guard 'if not (n > 0 and dim > 0 and len(m) == n * dim and len(q) == dim), do: raise' and n, dim as parameters, the same checks stay. Workaround used: a literal dimension (@dim 384, n = div(len(m), @dim)) drops both checks, and q copied into a 384-element alloc drops q[j]'s. Measured with 8 partial sums, 100k x 384: 25 ms with runtime dim vs 20 ms with the literal (loaded machine). A row-major matrix with a runtime row length is a common kernel shape (embeddings, images with a stride). Related: defk-siy (variable block offset), defk-pic (alloc with n = min(...)), defk-9za (facts from a guarding if).
